key_insight: The paper introduces an ontology-grounded benchmark generator that creates multiple-choice reasoning tests with correct answers and verified distractors directly checked by an OWL reasoner.
engineering_relevance: This enables more trustworthy evaluation of LLM reasoning for scientific AI in domains like materials and biomedicine, where logical errors can make outputs unusable.
method: Generate MCQs automatically from axiomatized OWL 2 ontologies.
Create distractors by perturbing right-hand-side class expressions in class definitions.
Verify distractor incorrectness with reasoner-based entailment checks.
evidence_signal: The pipeline produced 112, 2,491, and 15,216 MCQs for Pizza, PMDco, and DOID, and six zero-shot LLMs achieved 41.1–76.8% accuracy versus a 25% random baseline.
watch_item: The approach depends on sufficiently axiomatized OWL ontologies, so coverage and quality may be limited by ontology completeness and modeling style.
paper_title: Ontology-Grounded, Reasoner-Verified Benchmarks for Evaluating LLM Reasoning in Scientific AI
